hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 003 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until hyper-accuracy review and matching rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact source visuals, brand names, color identity, imagery, icon systems, decorative geometry, or section order.

commercialPurpose: Create a contact page that feels editorial and relational before asking for form submission.
purposeLayer: Contact page warms up the inquiry with image/story blocks, advertise/contact copy, then a centered form.
anatomyLayer: Two introductory image blocks, text invitation, secondary advertise block, centered form heading, name/email/message fields, and full-width submit button.
hierarchyLayer: Visual greeting first, contact invitation second, advertise/service note third, form action last.
gridRhythmLayer: Alternating two-column editorial rows above a centered form block with wide white margins.
densityLimitLayer: Use 2 image/text intro modules, 3-5 form fields, 1 submit action, and optional advertise/service inquiry block.
originalityLayer: Learn relational contact pacing; do not copy exact images, email text, gold submit bar, or sparse Pallas spacing.
usageRuleLayer: Use for creators, boutique studios, service providers, restaurants, consultants, and editorial brands needing softer inquiry flow.
layoutGesture: editorial contact story modules leading into centered form
sectionSilhouette: two airy image-copy rows over a wide centered form
compositionTension: warm visual storytelling delays the form until intent is clearer
focalPath: image pair to say-hello copy to advertise block to form
negativeSpaceShape: stacked white galleries and wide form runway
depthLayering: flat editorial image blocks with form surface at the end
moduleScaleVariation: medium paired images followed by wide form fields
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact contact imagery, email addresses, gold button, or Pallas signature branding.
